Run an assembly fallback (Option B2 baiting / Option A de-novo)

Source: R/run_fallback.R
run_fallback.Rd

Queues samples for the fallback workflow and launches it. By default it targets samples that failed the primary GetOrganelle assembly QC gate (no assembly, or a missing 18S/28S anchor); pass `ids` to force a specific set (e.g. an Option A whole-assembly cross-check of a good sample).

Usage

run_fallback(
  path = ".",
  ids = NULL,
  method = c("bait", "denovo"),
  nextflow = "nextflow",
  work = file.path(path, "work"),
  conda_env = NULL,
  ribopilot_src = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Project directory (contains `.sqlite` and `.config`).

ids

Sample IDs to run (default: the QC-gate failures).

method

"bait" (B2 reference-guided baiting, default) or "denovo" (Option A, assemble all reads).

nextflow

Path to the `nextflow` binary.

work

Nextflow work directory (default `<path>/work`).

conda_env

Optional conda env providing the tools; its `bin/` is prepended to PATH for the run.

ribopilot_src

Package source for the R-script processes.

Value

(invisibly) the Nextflow exit status (or 0 if nothing queued).
